NAir.AIR_INVASION_PREPARE_DAYS.comment: base days needed to prepare an airborne invasion

NAir.AIR_INVASION_PLAN_CAP.comment: base cap of airborne invasions can be planned at the same time

NAir.AIR_WING_FLIGHT_SPEED_MULT.comment: Global speed multiplier for airplanes (affects fe.transferring to another base)

NAir.AIR_WING_MAX_SIZE.comment: Max amount of airplanes in wing

NAir.AIR_WING_AVERAGE_SIZE.comment: Eyeballed average amount of airplanes in wing. Used when calculating air volunteer.

NAir.AIR_WING_BOMB_DAMAGE_FACTOR.comment: Used to balance the damage done while bombing.

NAir.BASE_AIR_INVASION_DIVISION_CAP.comment: base cap of divisions that can be assigned in a airborne invasion

NAir.BIGGEST_AGILITY_FACTOR_DIFF.comment: biggest factor difference in agility for doing damage (caps to this)

NAir.BIGGEST_SPEED_FACTOR_DIFF.comment: biggest factor difference in speed for doing damage (caps to this)

NAir.TOP_SPEED_DAMAGE_BONUS_FACTOR.comment: A factor for scaling the top speed of a plane into damage buff. If an attacking wing has a speed advantage of any form their speed value will be converted into a percentage bonus with this modifier

NAir.COMBAT_BETTER_AGILITY_DAMAGE_REDUCT.comment: How much the better agility (than opponent's) can reduce their damage to us.

NAir.COMBAT_BETTER_SPEED_DAMAGE_INCREASE.comment: How much the better Speed (than opponent's) can reduce increase our damage to them.

NAir.COMBAT_MAX_WINGS_AT_ONCE.comment: Max amount of air wings in one combat simulation. The higher value, the quicker countries may loose their wings. It's a gameplay balance value.

NAir.COMBAT_MAX_WINGS_AT_GROUND_ATTACK.comment: we can really pounce a land strike and escalate

NAir.COMBAT_MAX_WINGS_AT_ONCE_PORT_STRIK.comment: we can really pounce a naval strike and escalate

NAir.COMBAT_MULTIPLANE_CAP.comment: How many planes can shoot at each plane on other side ( if there are 100 planes we are atttacking COMBAT_MULTIPLANE_CAP * 100 of our planes can shoot )

NAir.COMBAT_DAMAGE_SCALE.comment: Higher value = more shot down planes

NAir.COMBAT_DAMAGE_SCALE_CARRIER.comment: same as above but used inside naval combat for carrier battles

NAir.CARRIER_PERCENTAGE_DEFEND.comment: Percentage of planes able to defend a carrier from air attacks (historically 15% - 35%)

NAir.DETECT_CHANCE_FROM_OCCUPATION.comment: How much the controlled provinces in area affects the air detection base value.

NAir.DETECT_CHANCE_FROM_RADARS.comment: How much the radars in area affects detection chance.

NAir.DETECT_CHANCE_FROM_AIRCRAFTS_EFFECT.comment: Max amount of aircrafts in region to give full detection bonus.

NAir.DETECT_CHANCE_FROM_AIRCRAFTS.comment: How much aircrafts in region improves air detection (up to effective count).

NAir.DETECT_CHANCE_FROM_NIGHT.comment: How much the night can reduce the air detection. (see static modifiers to check how weather affects it too.)

NAir.DETECT_EFFICIENCY_BASE.comment: Base value for detection efficiency (once something detected, efficiency says how many airplanes was detected).

NAir.DETECT_EFFICIENCY_FROM_RADAR.comment: How much radars affect the efficiency.

NAir.DETECT_EFFICIENCY_RANDOM_FACTOR.comment: How much randomness is in amount of detected aircrafts.

NAir.DAY_NIGHT_COVERAGE_FACTOR.comment: The max night coverage in a region that is still considered to be day-time when determining if day/night air missions shall run.

NAir.HOURS_DELAY_AFTER_EACH_COMBAT.comment: How many hours needs the wing to be ready for the next combat. Use for tweaking if combats happens too often. (generally used as double because of roundtrip)

NAir.CARRIER_HOURS_DELAY_AFTER_EACH_COMB.comment: how often carrier planes do battle inside naval combat

NAir.CARRIER_SIZE_STAT_INCREMENT.comment: Each Point of carrier_size state adds capacity for this many planes

NAir.SUBMARINE_CARRIER_SIZE_STAT_INCREME.comment: Each Point of carrier_size state adds capacity for this many planes for submarines

NAir.MISSILE_LAUNCHER_CAPACITY.comment: The number of missiles per slot

NAir.MISSILE_LAUNCHER_SLOTS.comment: The number of missile slots a missile launcher unit can have

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_TARGETTING_TO_AMOUNT.comment: Balancing value to convert the naval_strike_targetting equipment stats to chances of how many airplanes managed to do successfull strike.

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_STR.comment: Balancing value to convert damage ( naval_strike_attack * hits ) to Strength reduction.

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_DAMAGE_TO_ORG.comment: Balancing value to convert damage ( naval_strike_attack * hits ) to Organisation reduction.

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_CARRIER_MULTIPLIER.comment: damage bonus when planes are in naval combat where their carrier is present (and can thus sortie faster and more effectively)

NAir.FIELD_EXPERIENCE_MAX_PER_DAY.comment: Most xp you can gain per day

NAir.CLOSE_AIR_SUPPORT_EXPERIENCE_SCALE.comment: How much the experinence gained by CAS is scaled

NAir.PARADROP_EXPERIENCE_SCALE.comment: How much the experinence gained by paradropping is scaled

NAir.BOMBING_DAMAGE_EXPERIENCE_SCALE.comment: How much the experinence gained by bombing is scaled

NAir.EXPERIENCE_SCALE_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_N.comment: How much country experinence gained by attacking consumers who aren't motorized
How much country experinence gained by attacking node/trains

NAir.EXPERIENCE_SCALE_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_T.comment: How much country experinence gained by attacking trucks

NAir.FIELD_EXPERIENCE_FACTOR.comment: Factor all air experience gain from missions by this

NAir.AI_ALLOWED_PLANES_KEPT_IN_RESERVE.comment: AI allowed planes is reduced by this percentage. Overflow will be distributed to the next valid order. Worst case, this will result in this % of planes no being assigned any order.

NAir.ACCIDENT_CHANCE_BASE.comment: Base chance % (0 - 100) for accident to happen. Reduced with higher reliability stat.

NAir.ACCIDENT_CHANCE_CARRIER_MULT.comment: The total accident chance is scaled up when it happens on the carrier ship.

NAir.ACCIDENT_CHANCE_BALANCE_MULT.comment: Multiplier for balancing how often the air accident really happens. The higher mult, the more often.

NAir.ACCIDENT_CHANCE_RELIABILITY_MULT.comment: Multiplier to accident chance per point of missing reliability.

NAir.ACCIDENT_EFFECT_MULT.comment: Multiplier for balancing the effect of accidents

NAir.ACE_DEATH_CHANCE_BASE.comment: Base chance % for ace pilot die when an airplane is shot down in the Ace wing.

NAir.ACE_DEATH_BY_OTHER_ACE_CHANCE.comment: chance to an ace dying by another ace if it was hit by ace in combat

NAir.ACE_DEATH_CHANCE_PLANES_MULT.comment: The more airplanes was lost in a single airplanes (more bloody it was) the higher chance of Ace to die.

NAir.AIR_AGILITY_TO_NAVAL_STRIKE_AGILITY.comment: conversion factor to bring agility in line with ship AA

NAir.ACE_EARN_CHANCE_BASE.comment: Base chance % for ace pilot creation roll to happen. Happens only when successfully kill airplane/ship or damage the buildings.

NAir.ACE_EARN_CHANCE_PLANES_MULT.comment: Ace generation chance per aircraft. Chance is rolled twice because decimal numbers can't be small enough

NAir.AIR_DAMAGE_TO_DIVISION_LOSSES.comment: factor for conversion air damage to division losses for details statistics of air wings

NAir.AIR_NAVAL_KAMIKAZE_DAMAGE_MULT.comment: Balancing value to increase usual damage to Strength for Kamikaze

NAir.AIR_NAVAL_KAMIKAZE_LOSSES_MULT.comment: Balancing value to increase usual losses if Kamikaze participating in the battle

NAir.BASE_KAMIKAZE_TARGETING.comment: Kamikaze can't be a bad target

NAir.BASE_STRATEGIC_BOMBING_HIT_SHIP_CHA.comment: Chance to hit a ship in port when it is bombed.

NAir.BASE_STRATEGIC_BOMBING_HIT_PLANE_CH.comment: Chance to hit a plane in airbase when it is bombed.

NAir.AGGRESSION_THRESHOLD.comment: Threshold levels for mission aggressivity for air

NAir.ACE_WING_SIZE.comment: size of wing ace bonuses are set up for. if lower more bonus, if higher less bonus

NAir.ACE_WING_SIZE_MAX_BONUS.comment: biggest bonus we can get from having a small wing with an ace on

NAir.NO_SEARCH_MISSION_DETECT_FACTOR.comment: value of planes not on active search missions for detection

NAir.SUPPLY_PRIO_FACTOR.comment: Effect of supply need per unit for target province picking for air supply

NAir.CAPACITY_PENALTY.comment: scales penalty of having overcrowded bases.

NAir.AIR_COMBAT_FINAL_DAMAGE_SCALE.comment: % how many max disrupted only planes are alloed to die in a single combat

NAir.AIR_COMBAT_FINAL_DAMAGE_PLANES.comment: scaling/control for when only very few planes exist to stop roundoff issues

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_DETECTION_BALANCE_FACT.comment: Value used to scale the surface_visibility stats to balance the gameplay, so 100% detection chance still won't spam the strikes.

NAir.NAVAL_RECON_DETECTION_BALANCE_FACTO.comment: Value used to scale the surface_visibility stats to balance the gameplay, so 100% detection chance still won't spam spotting.

NAir.ANTI_AIR_ATTACK_TO_DAMAGE_REDUCTION.comment: Balancing value to convert equipment stat anti_air_attack to the damage reduction modifier apply to incoming air attacks against units with AA.

NAir.ANTI_AIR_MAXIMUM_DAMAGE_REDUCTION_F.comment: Maximum damage reduction factor applied to incoming air attacks against units with AA.

NAir.AIR_DEPLOYMENT_DAYS.comment: Days to deploy one air wing

NAir.NAVAL_STRIKE_BASE_STR_TO_PLANES_RAT.comment: Max airbombers to do port strike comparing to strength

NAir.NAVAL_COMBAT_EXTERNAL_PLANES_JOIN_R.comment: Max planes that can join a combat comparing to the total strength of the ships
max extra plane % that can join every day

NAir.NAVAL_COMBAT_EXTERNAL_PLANES_MIN_CA.comment: Min cap for planes that can join naval combat

NAir.AIR_MORE_GROUND_CREWS_COST.comment: CP cost to maintain more ground crews

NAir.AIR_MORE_GROUND_CREWS_BOOST.comment: Efficienct boost for more ground crews

NAir.EFFICIENCY_REGION_CHANGE_DAILY_GAIN.comment: Default how much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.
How much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.
How much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.
How much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.
How much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.
How much efficiency to regain per day. Gain applied hourly.

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_LEVELS.comment: Experience needed to progress to the next level

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_LOSS_WHEN_KILLED.comment: if a plane dies, the game assumes that a pilot with this amount of xp died and recalcs average.

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_TRAINING_MAX.comment: Max average XP achieved with training.

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_TRAINING_MISSION_GAIN_D.comment: Daily gain when running training exercise mission

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_AIR_VS_AIR_COMBAT_GAIN.comment: Wings in combat gain extra XP

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_GROUND_MISSION_COMPLETE.comment: Bombers bombing, CAS cassing, NBs nbing, kamikazees kamikazeeing, etc.

NAir.AIR_WING_COUNTRY_XP_FROM_TRAINING_F.comment: Factor on country Air XP gained from wing training

NAir.AIR_WING_XP_LOSS_REDUCTION_OVER_FRI.comment: Reduction on XP loss over friendly territory

NAir.DISRUPTION_FACTOR.comment: multiplier on disruption damage to scale its effects on planes

NAir.DISRUPTION_FACTOR_CARRIER.comment: multiplier on disruption damage to scale its effects on carrier vs carrier planes

NAir.CARRIER_PLANES_AMOUNT_FOR_POSITIONI.comment: below this amount of planes on a carrier we no longer get max benefit on enemy positioning

NAir.CAS_NIGHT_ATTACK_FACTOR.comment: CAS damaged get multiplied by this in land combats at night

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_NO_TRUCK_.comment: If a unit isn't motorized, still disrupt its supply by damage * this

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_INFRA_DAM.comment: Portion of truck damage to additionally deal to infrastructure

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_RAILWAY_D.comment: Portion of train damage to additionally deal to railways

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_DISRUPTIO.comment: Multiply train damage by this factor, scale from 1.0 at 0 disruption to this at AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_MAX_DISRUPTION_DAMAGE_TO_CONSIDER

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_DIRECT_DI.comment: Disruption damage to supply throughput done by bombing damage, not dependant on killing trains which also causes diruption.

NAir.AIR_WING_ATTACK_LOGISTICS_TRUCK_MAX.comment: max trucks we can destroy in one instance of a logistics strike

NAir.SECONDARY_DAMAGE_STRAT.comment: how much damage gets translated to railway guns for strat bombing

NAir.SECONDARY_DAMAGE_LOGISTICS.comment: how much damage gets translated to railway guns for logistic strike

NAir.INTERCEPTION_DISTANCE_SCALE.comment: At this many pixels of path length, full interception efficiency is applied to air missions. Lerp from 0.

NAir.INTERCEPTION_DAMAGE_SCALE.comment: Multiply the interception damage with this value. Works as a cap when interception distance is at maximum.

NAir.MANPOWER_LOSS_RATIO_PLANE_SHOT.comment: The loss ratio of manpower for a shot plane.

NAir.MISSION_COMMAND_POWER_COSTS.comment: command power cost per plane to create a mission

NAir.MISSION_FUEL_COSTS.comment: fuel cost per plane for each mission

NAir.MAX_FUEL_FLOW_MULT.comment: max fuel flow ratio for planes, which will be multiplied by supply

NAir.FUEL_COST_MULT.comment: fuel multiplier for all air missions

NAir.MISSION_EFFICIENCY_MULT_AT_LACK_OF_.comment: multiplier for mission efficiency when a base lacks fuel

NAir.STRATEGIC_BOMBING_PROV_BUILD_PRIO_S.comment: Scale of the selected priority for provincial buildings

NAir.STRATEGIC_BOMBING_STATE_BUILD_PRIO_.comment: Scale of the selected priority for state buildings

NAir.STRATEGIC_BOMBING_INFRA_PRIO_SCALE.comment: Scale of the selected priority for infrastructure

NAir.STRATEGIC_BOMBING_RAILWAY_PRIORITY_.comment: The scale of extra priority assigned to railway for strategic bombing

NAir.STRATEGIC_BOMBING_STATE_BUILDING_SC.comment: The scale of state building priority for strategic bombing

NAir.NAVAL_MINES_PLANTING_SPEED_MULT.comment: Value used to overall balance of the speed of planting naval mines

NAir.NAVAL_MINES_PLANTING_SPEED_LOWER_BO.comment: Speed of planting naval mines can not be lower than this

NAir.NAVAL_MINES_SWEEPING_SPEED_MULT.comment: Value used to overall balance of the speed of sweeping naval mines

NAir.NAVAL_MINES_SWEEPING_SPEED_LOWER_BO.comment: Speed of sweeping naval mines can not be lower than this

NAir.NON_CORE_STRATEGIC_IMPACT.comment: multiplier for strategic impact of non-core bombing

NAir.REINFORCEMENT_DISABLING_DURATION_IN.comment: The reinforcement disabling duration in hours when transfering from land to carrier and vice versa

NAir.THRUST_WEIGHT_AGILITY_FACTOR.comment: For plane designs, additive agility bonus per point of thrust exceeding weight

NAir.MAX_QUICK_WING_SELECTION.comment: Max possible selection for airwing quick deploy

NAir.USE_SINGLE_NAVAL_ARMAMENT_CATEGORY.comment: If true, only the armament module category that inflicts the greatest damage to naval targets will contribute naval strike and port strike mission specific stats. Only modules with both naval_strike_attack and naval_strike_targetting are considered. This is used to prevent torpedo_mounting and bomb_locks stats from stacking.

NAir.PORT_STRIKE_DAMAGE_FACTOR.comment: How much damage is dealt to ports during a port strike (per plane damage [complex number] * num flying planes * define)
